# JUDO Runtime Core

> Multi-module Java runtime engine that powers the JUDO low-code platform, providing data access, business logic, REST API serving, and security for model-driven applications.

JUDO Runtime Core is a 31-module Maven project that translates JUDO platform models (ASM/PSM/ESM) into working applications. It handles the full server-side stack: RDBMS-backed data access with Liquibase migrations, expression evaluation, query execution, CXF-based REST endpoints, Jackson serialization, and Keycloak security integration.

Key facts:
- Java 21, Maven multi-module build
- 31 modules organized in layers: DAO, business logic, security, serialization/API, and DI integration
- Dependency injection via Google Guice (primary) and Spring Boot (alternative)
- Database support: PostgreSQL (production) and HSQLDB (testing)
- REST API: Apache CXF JAX-RS with Jackson JSON
- Security: Keycloak OpenID Connect integration
- Licensed under Eclipse Public License v2.0

## Modules — Foundation

- [judo-runtime-core/pom.xml](judo-runtime-core/pom.xml): Core runtime abstractions — DataTypeManager, identifier providers, metrics, and common exceptions
- [judo-runtime-core-dependencies/pom.xml](judo-runtime-core-dependencies/pom.xml): Centralized dependency management (BOM) for consistent versioning across all modules

## Modules — Data Access Layer

- [judo-runtime-core-dao-core/agent-docs/README.md](judo-runtime-core-dao-core/agent-docs/README.md): Core DAO interfaces and abstractions for data access
- [judo-runtime-core-dao-rdbms/README.md](judo-runtime-core-dao-rdbms/README.md): RDBMS DAO implementation with query translation, statement executors, and result mapping
- [judo-runtime-core-dao-rdbms-hsqldb/agent-docs/README.md](judo-runtime-core-dao-rdbms-hsqldb/agent-docs/README.md): HSQLDB database dialect provider for development and testing
- [judo-runtime-core-dao-rdbms-postgresql/agent-docs/README.md](judo-runtime-core-dao-rdbms-postgresql/agent-docs/README.md): PostgreSQL database dialect provider for production use
- [judo-runtime-core-dao-rdbms-liquibase/agent-docs/README.md](judo-runtime-core-dao-rdbms-liquibase/agent-docs/README.md): Liquibase integration for database schema management and migrations

## Modules — Business Logic & Processing

- [judo-runtime-core-expression/agent-docs/README.md](judo-runtime-core-expression/agent-docs/README.md): Expression evaluation engine for dynamic values and conditions
- [judo-runtime-core-query/agent-docs/README.md](judo-runtime-core-query/agent-docs/README.md): Query processing and translation layer converting abstract queries to SQL
- [judo-runtime-core-dispatcher/agent-docs/README.md](judo-runtime-core-dispatcher/agent-docs/README.md): Request dispatching and operation processing with ANTLR-based parsing
- [judo-runtime-core-validator/agent-docs/README.md](judo-runtime-core-validator/agent-docs/README.md): Data validation framework for enforcing business rules and constraints

## Modules — Security & Access Control

- [judo-runtime-core-security/agent-docs/README.md](judo-runtime-core-security/agent-docs/README.md): Core security framework with authentication and authorization abstractions
- [judo-runtime-core-security-keycloak/agent-docs/README.md](judo-runtime-core-security-keycloak/agent-docs/README.md): Keycloak OAuth2/OpenID Connect provider integration
- [judo-runtime-core-security-keycloak-cxf/agent-docs/README.md](judo-runtime-core-security-keycloak-cxf/agent-docs/README.md): Keycloak integration with Apache CXF for JAX-RS security
- [judo-runtime-core-accessmanager-api/agent-docs/README.md](judo-runtime-core-accessmanager-api/agent-docs/README.md): Access control API defining permission and role abstractions
- [judo-runtime-core-accessmanager/agent-docs/README.md](judo-runtime-core-accessmanager/agent-docs/README.md): Access control implementation with permission checking

## Modules — Serialization & API
